properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].path
properties.description: Ant-style URI pattern this rule applies to (e.g. /api/**).

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].methods
properties.description: HTTP methods this rule applies to (e.g. GET, POST). Omit or leave empty to match all methods.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].enabled
properties.description: Set to false to silence all logging (request and response) for matching requests. Defaults to true.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].request.enabled
properties.description: Set to false to suppress the request log entry entirely for this rule. Defaults to true.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].request.payload.enabled
properties.description: When true, the request body is captured and included in the log entry.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].request.headers.enabled
properties.description: When true, request headers are captured and included in the log entry.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].request.headers.include
properties.description: Header names to include (case-insensitive). When empty or null all headers are included subject to the exclude list.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].request.headers.exclude
properties.description: Header names to exclude from the log entry (case-insensitive). Takes precedence over include.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].response.enabled
properties.description: Set to false to suppress the response log entry entirely for this rule. Defaults to true.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].response.payload.enabled
properties.description: When true, the response body is captured and included in the log entry.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].response.headers.enabled
properties.description: When true, response headers are captured and included in the log entry.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].response.headers.include
properties.description: Header names to include (case-insensitive). When empty or null all headers are included subject to the exclude list.

properties.name: platform.rest.server.logging.rules[*].response.headers.exclude
properties.description: Header names to exclude from the log entry (case-insensitive). Takes precedence over include.
